apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 210 reduces NIS allocation pressure on target changes. Retires old Metal 4 texture pools safely and avoids a duplicate NIS fallback pool while preparation finishes. Keeps Screen/1.5×/2× targets, MetalFX/NIS/FSR1, adaptive HDR and rendering/controller fixes. Full-size NIS checks at 3840×1620 and 5120×2160, Metal 4 handoff, simulator check and Release archive passed. Reported iPhone freeze requires device verification. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
